rawContent: Hey @KTLA … it’d be a great service to the community that if during your reporting you mentioned #ClimateChange. It’s happening all around us now in real time and the media needs to warn the people. Please and thank you. 🙏🏾

I see so many mentioning #HurricaneIan & so few mentioning #climatechange. There’s a reason these storms are intensifying all over world. 

Florida dont need prayers. The state & the rest of the world need responsible governance to halt our addiction to fossil fuels🌎
